newsitem.title: USA: Tornado damages buildings in Houston suburb.
newsitem.headline: Tornado damages buildings in Houston suburb.

text.p: Buildings were damaged and power lines knocked down on Monday when a tornado roared through a Houston suburb, police said.
Eyewitnesses said the storm blew debris 300 feet into the air as it ripped through a two-mile swath of Pasadena, Texas southeast of Houston.

Rescue officials were combing through buildings damaged in the storm, but said there were no reports of injuries. Television reports showed a church with its steeple knocked off, a storage building reduced to rubble, and several heavily damaged commercial buildings.
Philip Riegel told reporters he was driving his children home from school when he spotted the tornado coming down one of Pasadena's main avenues.
"It reminded me of that movie 'Twister'...it was a very, very frightening experience. We're all still shaking from it," he said.
Houston Lighting and Power officials said 5,500 customers were left without electricity by the storm.
